publisherUid.description: Uid of the account that publishes the document.

parentCapabilities.description: Capabilities inherited from ancestor paths, one per account.

grantedCapabilities.description: Capabilities granted directly on this document, one per account.

grantedMembers.description: Accounts with a capability on the document, as `writer` or `member` rows, one per canonical account.

members.description: Accounts that subscribed to the site through a contact, excluding those already in `grantedMembers`.

accounts.description: Metadata payloads for the publisher and every account listed above, keyed by uid.

description: A document's collaboration picture: its publisher, inherited and direct capabilities, members, and their metadata.
